title: Dragon Vein Emergency
next_chapter_hook: The moment that strand of energy touched his divine sense, Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply—that was a Heavenly Fate fluctuation unique to his long-missing sister, Chen Nian.

text.content: The ink hadn't yet dried, yet Chen Ji showed no composure in his writing at all. That cold feeling of being watched was like a tangible needle, piercing inch by inch into the back of his neck. He maintained his brush-holding posture, but his breathing had already quietly slowed, and the true elemental energy within his body operated along an extremely covert trajectory, ready at any moment to activate the Tianji Record. Outside the window, wind passed through the bamboo grove, rustling, but within that sound was夹杂着 another kind of sound—extremely faint and light, as if someone was deliberately suppressing their breath.

dialogue.content: Since you're here, why hide in the shadows?

text.content: As the words fell, the bamboo shadows outside the window subtly swayed. An elderly yet majestic aura surged forth like a tide, instantly enveloping the entire meditation chamber. Chen Ji's heart sank—this aura was all too familiar to him. It was Ling Yuan, the former sect master of Tianqing Sect. But strangely, although the other party had clearly locked onto his position, they refused to appear, as if waiting for something. Was it waiting for him to reveal a weakness, or for some particular moment? Chen Ji lowered his gaze, his fingertips quietly brushing against the fragment in his sleeve, and the foresight power of the Tianji Record stirred faintly.

At that moment, the earth suddenly quaked. The sky outside the window cracked open with a blinding white light, as if the heavens had been torn apart by some force. Then, an extremely vast tide of energy erupted from that fissure, sweeping across in all directions. Bamboo leaves scattered, roof tiles trembled, and even Ling Yuan's mountain-like pressure was somewhat dispersed by this sudden upheaval.

dialogue.content: The Dragon Vein... has encountered a problem.

text.content: The voice of the residual soul guardian rang in Chen Ji's mind, rarely carrying a hint of urgency. 'The space-time rift has completely torn open due to the Dragon Vein core's loss of control, and experts from the three major sects are rushing over. Ling Yuan has already set out—he won't miss this opportunity.' Chen Ji's eyes flickered slightly, his mind rapidly calculating. Ling Yuan had long coveted the Dragon Vein core, and if he succeeded, his own plans would surely be constrained by others. But that earlier gaze of observation was clearly directed at him and the Tianji Record.

The energy tide continued to ravage, yet within this chaos, Chen Ji caught a trace of something unusual. When that violent force swept across his divine sense, the Tianji Record fragment in his sleeve actually grew slightly warm, as if responding to some kind of summoning. He closed his eyes in concentration, and upon that fragment emerged a blurry image—deep within the rift, the faint outline of an ancient ruin was visible, and the patterns flowing across it closely resembled the characters of the Tianji Record.

dialogue.content: That is... the ancient dojo of the Pavilion of Heavenly Secrets.

text.content: The residual soul guardian's voice suddenly rose sharply, 'One of the sources of the Tianji Record is actually sealed within the depths of the Dragon Vein! If one could enter, the fragment might be completed, and even a glimpse of the complete art of fate divination might be obtained. But that place is certainly extremely dangerous—' Before the words finished, another earth-shaking tremor occurred, and in the distant sky, several streaks of flying light could already be seen streaking through the air.

choice.prompt: The experts from the three major sects are approaching, Ling Yuan has already taken the lead, and the temptation of the Dragon Vein core and ancient ruins lies right before you—Chen Ji, how will you choose?

choices.description: Before the experts from the three major sects arrive, immediately head to the rift and make contact with the Dragon Vein core and ancient ruins before Ling Yuan
choices.visible_cost: Consume 10 Heavenly Fate points and expose your position in advance
choices.visible_reward: Prioritize making contact with the ancient ruins to obtain clues for completing the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: May directly confront Ling Yuan and fall into a bitter battle

dialogue.content: A sharp gleam flashed in Chen Ji's eyes as the prophetic image from the fragment intertwined with the current crisis, piecing together a breathtaking chess game. He hesitated no longer, his form turning into a blur as he rushed out of the meditation chamber, heading directly toward the direction of the Dragon Vein rift. Wind howled past his ears, and the fragment at his chest burned increasingly hot, as if urging him to quicken his pace.

choices.text: Observe from the shadows and seize advantage through the situation
choices.description: Conceal your aura, follow behind the experts of the three major sects, and wait for an opportunity to act when Ling Yuan is fighting with others
choices.visible_cost: Miss the opportunity to get there first and may be beaten to the ruins by others
choices.visible_reward: Avoid direct confrontation and obtain the maximum benefit in the chaos
choices.risk_hint: The ruins may be destroyed, or key items may be taken by others

dialogue.content: A subtle smile curved at the corner of Chen Ji's lips, revealing a meaningful grin. He took out a concealing talisman from his sleeve, suppressing his own aura to near nothingness, then quietly slipped into the shadows. The mantis stalks the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind—this had always been his specialty: letting others pave the way for him.

choices.text: Force Ling Yuan to reveal himself
choices.description: Use the Tianji Record to trace back the observer's position, forcing Ling Yuan to reveal himself early and confront him, disrupting the enemy's plans
choices.visible_cost: Directly break with Ling Yuan, leaving no room for maneuver
choices.visible_reward: Disrupt Ling Yuan's arrangements, preventing him from laying out his plans unhurriedly
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan's strength is unfathomable; direct confrontation is extremely dangerous

dialogue.content: "Since you want to see my cards, I'll let you see them all." Chen Ji coldly smiled. The Tianji Record Fragment suddenly burst forth with a ghostly blue light, and a thread of destiny shot out from his divine sense, pointing directly at the source of the observation power. A moment later, a cold hum came from the depths of the Bamboo Grove, and Ling Yuan's figure finally revealed itself—with an enigmatic smile spreading across that aged face.

text.content: Ling Yuan emerged from the bamboo shadows with measured steps, his emaciated form radiating suffocating pressure. His gaze fixed on the fragment in Chen Ji's hand, flickering with a complex mix of greed and wariness. "The dragon vein's agitation, yet the Tianji Record sensed it in advance—impressive indeed." The old sect master's tone resembled praising a junior, but deep within those murky eyes slumbered a viper's coldness. "Only, placing such a treasure in your hands is truly a waste."

dialogue.content: The old sect master speaks boldly, but I wonder if his actual skill matches his mouth.

text.content: Ling Yuan not only failed to grow angry at the words but burst into laughter instead—苍老 yet jarring. "Courageous indeed. No wonder the Tianji Record chose you." He took a step forward, the ground beneath his feet suddenly cracking apart, and a torrent of true essence gushed forth like a mountain flood. "But do you truly believe that with a broken artifact, you can contend against this old man? Today the dragon vein stirs, masters from the three great sects have gathered—do you think you can escape unscathed?"

Chen Ji's expression shifted slightly, yet quickly regained composure. He knew Ling Yuan spoke truth—at this moment, he truly lacked the capital to confront the old sect master directly. But the old fox forgot one thing: Chen Ji had never been one to win through brute force. Just as Ling Yuan pressed forward relentlessly, a blinding white light erupted once more across the distant horizon, the temporal rift expanding visibly to the naked eye.

dialogue.content: It seems there's no time for idle talk with you.

text.content: A sharp gleam flashed in Ling Yuan's eyes. His form vanished in an instant, and the next second he appeared merely three chi from Chen Ji. He raised his palm and struck toward Chen Ji's chest, the掌风 sharp as a blade, forcing the air to emit a piercing shriek. Yet at this critical moment, Chen Ji's lips curved into an uncanny smile—his figure, at the instant the palm wind made contact, shattered like a reflection in water.

"Old fox, you thought you were the only one maneuvering in the shadows?" Chen Ji's voice drifted over from several zhang away, its calmness bordering on cold indifference. Unbeknownst to anyone, he had already reached the rift's edge, standing on rocks riddled with holes from the dragon vein's energy. Ling Yuan's expression turned completely grim—he had clearly locked onto the man's spiritual presence. How could he have been so easily shaken off?

Chen Ji paid no heed to Ling Yuan's shock and doubt; his entire focus was captured by the temporal rift before him. Observed up close, the rift appeared far more ferocious than from afar—golden lightning flickered through the jet-black void, while chains of order extended from the rift's depths, attempting to seal the ever-expanding wound. Deepest within the rift, the silhouette of an ancient ruin grew increasingly distinct, its flowing runes resonating violently with the Tianji Record Fragment.

choice.prompt: Within the rift's depths, an ancient ruin exudes deadly temptation; behind, Ling Yuan prepares to strike; in the distance, masters from the three great sects approach—you must decide immediately!

choices.description: Leap directly into the temporal rift, gambling your life to enter the ancient ruins' interior in search of the method to complete the Tianji Record
choices.visible_cost: Withstand the temporal chaos's impact, potentially lost within the void
choices.visible_reward: Connect with the Tianji Record's source, obtaining the complete cultivation method and the art of fate divination
choices.risk_hint: Should one fail, one shall be trapped eternally within the temporal chaos

dialogue.content: Nothing ventured, nothing gained. Chen Ji drew a deep breath. The fragment in his sleeve suddenly blazed with resplendent light, shielding him from the temporal chaos's initial erosion. The next instant, he plunged into that jet-black rift. Behind him rang Ling Yuan's furious roar—the old fox had clearly never anticipated such resolve.

choices.text: Set up a trap to intercept Ling Yuan
choices.description: Use the Tianji Record to foresee Ling Yuan's movements, lay a formation trap at the rift's edge, and turn the tables when he gives chase
choices.visible_cost: Consumes massive true essence, potentially allowing Ling Yuan to see through the trap
choices.visible_reward: Severely wound Ling Yuan, intimidate the subsequent invaders
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan is extremely cunning, likely has backup measures prepared

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's eyes turned cold, his fingers rapidly forming seals. The prophetic images from the Tianji Record Fragment transformed into formation runes, silently embedding themselves into the rocks beneath his feet. Ling Yuan, do you think this old man fears you? A cold smile curled at the corner of his lips as his body simultaneously scattered into several phantoms, fleeing in different directions.

text.content: Ling Yuan's figure chased after like a specter to the edge of the rift, yet the instant he stepped into the formation range Chen Ji had set up, countless formation runes suddenly blazed beneath his feet. Brilliant light wove into an impenetrable net, trapping this old sect master within. Ling Yuan let out a cold snort, his withered palm swinging out fiercely, the palm wind like blades, causing the net to violently tremble.

Insignificant tricks! His killing intent surged violently, the true essence within his body pouring out like a tide. The layered formation runes began to crack. However, just as he was about to break through the formation, a figure shot out from the direction of the rift, holding in hand a jade slip emanating ancient aura. Chen Ji! How dare you— Ling Yuan's eyes burned crimson with extreme rage. He had been delayed by this waste using sleight of hand, watching the opportunity slip away before his very eyes!

Chen Ji landed several zhang away, the jade slip in his hand radiating a faint glow. It was a fragment he had seized from the edge of the ruins in the instant he leaped into the rift—though not the core object, it contained the long-lost introductory cultivation method of the Tianji Record. He did not linger, his body turning swiftly to flee into the distance. Ling Yuan's furious roars echoed behind him, yet were drowned out by the approaching escaping light and battle cries—the experts from the three great sects had finally arrived.

Amidst the chaos, Chen Ji silently slipped into the shadows of a mountain cliff. He sat cross-legged, pressing the jade slip against his brow center. Ancient characters surged into his mind like a tide. Tianji Record · Initial Volume · Chapter of Fate: To grasp Heavenly Secrets, one must first reverse Heavenly Fate; to reverse Heavenly Fate, one must first understand one's own heart. A faint smile curved his lips—this adventure was worth it.

Yet at this moment, a strange sensation arose in his heart. It was a reaction the Tianji Record Fragment had never shown before—as if in the distant depths of time and space, something was calling to him, or more precisely, pulling at him. Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes, his pupils reflecting the faint, barely visible figure deep within the rift. That figure was slender and indistinct, shrouded in a hazy glow, its features unclear, yet it gave him an incomparably familiar feeling.
The instant that wisp of aura touched his divine consciousness, Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply—that was the unique Heavenly Fate fluctuation belonging to his long-lost sister Chen Nian.
